observations: Both photos show a hand holding a blue PS4 game case for The Witcher: Wild Hunt.
The cover displays the PEGI 18 rating and CD Projekt Red logo.
The PS4 logo appears on the top banner of the case.
The background wall sign reads "Prezin Gadgets".
Neither photo shows the disc, the case interior, a receipt, or any controller pads.
No new photo or video was sent after the seller's reply.

claims.evidence: photos show case exterior only; seller's word is not proof
factory seal is not clearly visible in either photo
no way to verify repair history from photos
a game case has no cooling system; this claim applies to a console, which is not shown
a game case has no ports; this claim applies to a console, which is not shown
photos show only the game case; no pads or controllers are visible
no receipt is visible in either photo
no new photo or video was sent; seller's statement alone is not proof
seller's self-confirmation is not independent evidence

risks.risk: The case may be empty with no game disc inside.
risks.proof: Photo of the opened case showing the disc, or the disc held up to the camera.

risks.risk: The disc or case may be a counterfeit or pirate copy rather than an official release.
risks.proof: Close-up of the disc label, case spine, and back cover with barcode and region code.
risks.if_unproven: as a counterfeit or worthless case

risks.risk: The game may be the wrong region for Nigerian PS4 consoles or accounts.
risks.proof: Photo of the case spine or back showing the region code.

risks.risk: The listing may be bait-and-switch: the seller describes a console (overheating, ports, pads) but only shows a game.
risks.proof: Video showing the complete item and any included console, pads, or receipt.
risks.if_unproven: as a game case only, with no console or accessories

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the case showing region code and barcode
Photo of the opened case with the disc visible
Close-up of the disc surface and label
Photo or video of any receipt, pads, or console if included
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a PS4 copy of The Witcher: Wild Hunt, so it can be priced at its worst case as a game case only while the seller's unproven claims about a console, pads, receipt, and testing remain unverified.
